summary.description: Deep testing of data source (SRC) accessibility from SOPs in the pointer network
key_findings: Post-repair 3-hop SOP-to-SRC reachability is 61.7%, up from run-002's 36.4% (+25.3pp)
Without SCR->SRC repair links, baseline would be 43.2% — repairs contributed +18.5pp
100% of SOP-SRC pairs are reachable (unlimited hops), but only 61.7% within 3 hops
47/48 SRC nodes are well-connected (reachable from 5+ SOPs within 3 hops); 1 moderate, 0 isolated
Network is gateway-dependent: top 3 SCR gateways handle 43.3% of all SOP-SRC bridging
SCR-0007 is the most critical single point of failure — removing it breaks 32 SOP-SRC 3-hop paths

task_1_src_reverse_reachability.description: For each SRC, how many SOPs can reach it within 3 hops

task_2_distance_matrix.description: Shortest path distance from each SOP to each SRC (22x48 matrix)

task_3_post_repair_comparison.description: SOP-to-SRC reachability within 3 hops, before and after SCR->SRC repair links
task_3_post_repair_comparison.analysis: The network now achieves 61.7% 3-hop SOP-to-SRC reachability, a +25.3pp improvement over run-002's 36.4%. Of this improvement, +18.5pp is directly attributable to the 167 SCR->SRC links added by R2 repairs. The remaining +6.8pp comes from other network changes.

task_4_gateway_scripts.description: SCR nodes that serve as bridges on shortest SOP-to-SRC paths

concentration.assessment: High dependency — top 3 gateways handle 43.3% of all bridging, indicating fragility

recommendations: Add redundant paths to reduce dependency on SCR-0007 (32 pairs at risk)
Create direct SOP->SRC links for the most-accessed SRC nodes
Add alternative SCR bridges for SRC-0016 (only reachable from 2 SOPs within 3 hops)

task_5_journey_simulations.description: 15 data-gathering journeys targeting SRC nodes, logged via route_tracker
